jobs.name: Daily Laptop Backup

payload.message: Run the backup script: cd /home/pmpmt/.pi/apps-scripts/backup_laptop_tool/src/backup_PC_tool && python main.py. Report the result - whether it succeeded or failed and any relevant output.

jobs.description: Daily backup of ~/.pi configurations to Google Drive at 08:10 Lisbon time. Timezone: Europe/Lisbon

jobs.name: gog-token-keepalive

payload.message: Run 'gog drive ls' to refresh the Google OAuth token. If it fails with auth error, report the failure so the user knows they need to re-authenticate.

jobs.description: Daily Google OAuth token refresh to prevent expiry and detect failures early
